findings.title: Client-side limit hardcoded to 10MB ignoring SiteSettings
findings.body: validateUploadedFile in app/assets/javascripts/discourse/lib/utilities.js now uses `10 * 1024` for both `image` and `attachment` types instead of `Discourse.SiteSettings['max_' + type + '_size_kb']` (and displayErrorForUpload at line 246 does the same). This breaks admin configurability: attachments that should respect max_attachment_size_kb and images that should respect max_image_size_kb are both capped at 10MB, so larger allowed files are wrongly rejected client-side and smaller configured limits are not enforced, diverging from server-side validation.

findings.title: Remote download capped at hardcoded 10MB
findings.body: In app/controllers/uploads_controller.rb create_upload downloads API-provided URLs with a hardcoded `10.megabytes` limit instead of `SiteSetting.max_image_size_kb.kilobytes`. If an admin configures a larger max_image_size_kb, legitimate remote images larger than 10MB are truncated/rejected by FileHelper.download before the new downsize logic can run, so the feature does not work for URL uploads above 10MB.

findings.title: In-place ImageMagick downsize corrupts original
findings.body: In app/controllers/uploads_controller.rb line 67 calls `OptimizedImage.downsize(tempfile.path, tempfile.path, ...)` using the same path for source and destination. ImageMagick `convert` reading and writing the same file can truncate/corrupt the file, especially on failure. On failure the original upload bytes are lost and a partial/corrupt file is then passed to Upload.create_for.

findings.title: Downsize loop ignores conversion failure
findings.body: In app/controllers/uploads_controller.rb the `while attempt > 0 && tempfile.size > limit` loop at lines 66-69 never checks the return value of `OptimizedImage.downsize`. A failed conversion still decrements `attempt` and re-stats the same (possibly corrupt/unchanged) file, wasting up to 5 converts and then proceeding to `Upload.create_for` with an still-oversized or corrupted tempfile instead of surfacing an error.

findings.title: Duplicate downsize definition shadows width/height overload
findings.body: In app/models/optimized_image.rb there are two `self.downsize` definitions back-to-back: line 145 `downsize(from, to, max_width, max_height, opts)` and line 149 `downsize(from, to, dimensions, opts)`. Ruby has no overloading, so the second overwrites the first. Existing callers using the 5-argument form will have max_width bound to dimensions and max_height bound to opts, producing malformed geometry strings and wrong options and breaking thumbnail/downsize behavior.
